step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify visual nodes drawn on the whiteboard: Kinesis, DMS, S3, Step Functions, EMR (grouped inside a cloud boundary), Athena, Redshift, SageMaker, QuickSight.
2. Trace data ingestion flows: Kinesis and DMS both connect into S3 (landing layer).
3. Trace data processing/enrichment flows: S3 feeds into the Step Functions + EMR processing unit, which writes processed Parquet back into S3.
4. Trace data consumption flows: S3 feeds data directly to Athena and SageMaker (via long connecting line). SageMaker connects to Athena and Redshift. Athena connects to Redshift. QuickSight queries Redshift.
